verdicts.reason: Both separate the teal circle from the headphones, so the backdrop ends up stranded in the bottom-left corner behind the logo. Both put the price above the headline, mix a centered price and product with left-aligned copy, and shrink the subhead and Pre-order button until they are tiny. A at least keeps the CTA centered and clear of other elements. B shoves the Pre-order button into the bottom-left corner, overlapping the stray circle and crammed against the logo, and leaves a large empty band at the top.
